evidence.title: Imposter govt website targets Pakistan online users with free laptop ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated the claim of a genuine Pakistani govt website for a laptop giveaway scheme as False, stating that an imposter government website targets Pakistan online users with a free laptop scam.

outputs.notes_en: The fact checks consistently rate claims about government free laptop schemes as false or scams, indicating that no such official scheme exists. This directly contradicts the claim that the Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026 is providing free laptops to all students and that there is an official website for it. The claim about the last date to apply is also contradicted by the non-existence of the scheme itself.
